chapter: Changing styles, the road and nightlife
title: The 1952 theatre tour with MCA
summary: On the strength of Hambone his Chicago band played the Apollo, the Howard and Detroit.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you ever take your big band out on the road?

Yeah, right. I made a tour -- I was with MCA for a hot period there, and we played the Apollo Theatre in New York. We played the Howard Theatre in Washington, and we played Detroit. And I was on the road not too much of a time, but this was a brief period.

This was in '52. Yeah, around '52 when we went to the Howard -- we went to Baltimore -- not Baltimore, but New York, the Apollo in New York and the Howard Theatre in Washington, which both now since have closed.
Was this about the time when you had the 'Hambone' hit?
Yeah, I had that hit record, right. And this is one of the things that got us into the theatres and things at that particular time.
